title: standings splits Athletico Paranaense into two rows (name variant not reconciled)
evidence: SoccerData.m:79-81 groups the table by the raw home/away string (key = m["home"]/m["away"]); Fold() (SoccerData.m:13-26) folds diacritics and strips state suffixes but does NOT reconcile the 'Athletico' vs 'Atletico' spelling. _factual.json: 2019 Serie A returns 'Athletico Paranaense' (27 matches, 48 pts) and 'Atletico Paranaense' (11 matches, 16 pts) as two clubs instead of one 38-match club. NOTE: this is a data-quality/factual defect (already scored by factual_accuracy=0.5) — R9's stated criterion 'standings computed from matches, not hardcoded' IS met (SoccerData.m:76-88 aggregates points/W/D/L/goals from filtered matches), so it does not reduce requirement_coverage.
suggestion: Group standings by a canonical team key (fold the 'th' variant, e.g. map 'athletico'->'atletico') so the same club's matches merge; reuse the same canonicalization at load time.
